name: Little Menace
lore: This mouse brawler carries a pocketful of shrinking charms and an oversized sense of courage. Small does not mean safe: his boldest strike spends his own heartbeats.

primary.name: Three Knocks
primary.description: Three fast forward punches deal 8 damage each. Landing all three on the same foe slows it 35% for 2s.
primary.ui_brief: Melee • three 8-damage jabs • all three hits slow

secondary.name: Pocket Size
secondary.description: Shrink to half size for 4s: +50% movement speed and a smaller projectile hitbox. You can still attack and take damage; area attacks remain dangerous.
secondary.ui_brief: Shrink • 4 seconds • faster, smaller, still vulnerable

special.name: Heart on the Line
special.description: Charge visibly for 1 second at reduced movement speed, then Pay 50% of your maximum health. Each enemy within 165 reach takes that same raw damage before its defences. The cost bypasses your armour and may defeat you if your health is too low.

passive: Small Courage: landing all three punches grants 10% damage reduction for 1.5s.

technique.name: All In
technique.description: Spend 75% maximum health for greater damage, but a smaller circle.

attack.name: All In
attack.description: Charge for 1 second, then Pay 75% of maximum health to damage every foe within 110 reach for that amount. Can defeat you; the circle is smaller.

final_technique.name: Long Mischief
final_technique.description: Stay small longer, with a smaller speed increase.

attack.name: Long Mischief
attack.description: Shrink for 6s instead of 4, but gain only +30% movement speed. Still able to attack; no invulnerability.
